items.docs:
Download artifact by reference.

Args:
    artifact_ref: URL-encoded artifact reference (S3 path or local file path)
    current_user: Authenticated user from JWT token
    
Returns:
    StreamingResponse with file content
    
Security:
    - Validates user has access to the task that owns the artifact
    - Extracts task_id from artifact_ref path
    - Checks user is task owner or admin

View artifact content as text.

Args:
    artifact_ref: URL-encoded artifact reference (S3 path or local file path)
    current_user: Authenticated user from JWT token
    
Returns:
    JSON response with filename and content as text
    
Security:
    - Same authorization as download endpoint
    - Content limited to text files
